standard_prerequisites: the ideals of topologically nilpotent elements a in A and b in B for arrows of WAdm^Noeth, and the rig-closed prime notion (a prime q whose closure is contained in a unique maximal ideal m containing b)
finite type morphisms are stable under composition and restriction of rings (A/a to B/b finite type implies A/a to B/m finite type when b is contained in m)
core_obligations: For an arrow A to B of WAdm^Noeth with A/a to B/b of finite type and a rig-closed prime q of B, the residue field kappa of B/q is a finite type A/a-algebra.
The proof takes the unique maximal ideal m containing q, notes b is contained in m, and factors the finite type map A/a to B/b through B/m = kappa.
proof_roadmap: Pick the unique maximal ideal m containing the rig-closed q; b is contained in m.
Factor A/a to B/b to B/m = kappa; a quotient of a finite type algebra is finite type.
difficulty_reason: H2: a two-step factorization argument from the finite type hypothesis to the residue field.
